This adverse development is attributed to a reassessment of net claims incurred for prior periods. While the prior year (2016) experienced lower scale losses from events such as Hurricane Matthew and the Canadian Wildfires, the overall prior year development for 2017 was a net strengthening. The syndicate's gross premiums written for 2017 totaled GBP 246.484 million, with the largest contributions from Fire and other damage to property (59.74%) and Reinsurance acceptances (27.26%).

The report attributes 2017's higher overall claims activity to major hurricanes (Harvey, Irma and Maria) which drove the year loss experience; prior year (2016) large loss activity such as Hurricane Matthew and Canadian wildfires was described as lower scale in comparison.
